meta.title: Godot MCP status
meta.description: Shows the Godot icon with an MCP corner tag while the Godot editor is running. The tag's dot is blue when DSH is connected to the MCP server and gray when it is not; hovering shows the state, and the badge disappears when the editor closes. With no Godot MCP configured, a detected endpoint offers a copy-ready configuration row.

detectedGodot: Godot MCP detected — not configured yet
panelHint: Add this to the profile’s cordis.patch.yml, then reload the configuration.
